Reuse only protocol arguments; any necessary observer build must remain in this project and be separated from algorithm commits.
synthetic.next_nonblocking_step: Find already accepted synthetic A metadata before scheduling any mapping; no repeated A by default. Full synthetic run is required at final acceptance.

stalls.next_incident: Collect verified owned player/mapper thread stacks/wchan and playback ACK state before termination, without changing data or flow control.
